observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with a cracked screen, showing the lock screen with time 10:58 and date Saturday, October 24. The screen has visible vertical lines and cracks in the top left corner. The phone has a notch at the top, typical of iPhone X or later models.

Photo 1: Back view of the phone, showing a white or silver finish with the Apple logo and a vertical dual-camera module. The back glass is heavily cracked with spiderweb patterns. The word 'iPhone' is visible below the logo.
Photo 2: Side view of the phone, showing the metallic edge and volume buttons. The side appears intact with no visible damage, but the screen and back are clearly damaged.

read_from: photo 1 back: Apple logo and 'iPhone' text
photo 1 back: vertical dual-camera module with no flash between lenses, characteristic of iPhone X

risks.risk: The phone may not power on or may have display issues due to the cracked screen.
risks.proof: A video showing the phone turning on, displaying content, and responding to touch.

risks.risk: The cracked back glass may have damaged the internal components or battery.

risks.risk: The phone may have water damage or other internal issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the SIM tray, charging port, and speaker grills showing no corrosion or moisture.

proof_requests: Video of the phone turning on, displaying content, and responding to touch.
Close-up of the back glass damage to check for internal penetration.
Photo of the SIM tray, charging port, and speaker grills to check for water damage.
response.reason: The phone is identifiable as an iPhone X with significant visible damage to both screen and back glass. The seller's claim of minimal issues is contradicted by the photos. Without proof of functionality and internal condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be assessed further.
